sentences.hanzi: 白露季节到了。 早上，小明和丽丽一起去公园。 他们看见草地上有很多亮晶晶的露珠。 小明说：“我觉得这些露珠真漂亮，像小星星一样。” 丽丽说：“我也觉得很好看，我们问问奶奶为什么会有露珠吧。” 他们回家问奶奶。 奶奶笑着说：“白露以后，晚上天气变凉，空气中的水汽遇到冷的草叶，就变成小水珠，这就是露珠。” 小明和丽丽听了很高兴。 他们拿了一个小杯子，又去公园收集露珠。 丽丽说：“我们用这些露珠给家里的花浇水吧。” 小明说：“好主意，露珠一定很干净。” 他们小心地把露珠倒进杯子里。 秋天的早晨很凉快，他们觉得非常舒服。 回到家，他们把露珠浇在花上。 花儿好像更漂亮了。 奶奶说：“你们真懂事。” 小明和丽丽都笑了。
sentences.pinyin: Báilù jìjié dào le. Zǎoshang, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì yīqǐ qù gōngyuán. Tāmen kànjiàn cǎodì shàng yǒu hěn duō liàngjīngjīng de lùzhū. Xiǎomíng shuō: "Wǒ juéde zhèxiē lùzhū zhēn piàoliang, xiàng xiǎo xīngxing yīyàng." Lìlì shuō: "Wǒ yě juéde hěn hǎokàn, wǒmen wènwen nǎinai wèishénme huì yǒu lùzhū ba." Tāmen huíjiā wèn nǎinai. Nǎinai xiàozhe shuō: "Báilù yǐhòu, wǎnshang tiānqì biàn liáng, kōngqì zhōng de shuǐqì yùdào lěng de cǎoyè, jiù biànchéng xiǎo shuǐzhū, zhè jiù shì lùzhū." Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì tīng le hěn gāoxìng. Tāmen ná le yī gè xiǎo bēizi, yòu qù gōngyuán shōují lùzhū. Lìlì shuō: "Wǒmen yòng zhèxiē lùzhū gěi jiālǐ de huā jiāoshuǐ ba." Xiǎomíng shuō: "Hǎo zhǔyi, lùzhū yīdìng hěn gānjìng." Tāmen xiǎoxīn de bǎ lùzhū dào jìn bēizi lǐ. Qiūtiān de zǎochén hěn liángkuai, tāmen juéde fēicháng shūfu. Huí dào jiā, tāmen bǎ lùzhū jiāo zài huā shàng. Huār hǎoxiàng gèng piàoliang le. Nǎinai shuō: "Nǐmen zhēn dǒngshì." Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì dōu xiào le.
sentences.english: The White Dew season had arrived. In the morning, Xiaoming and Lili went to the park together. They saw many glistening dew drops on the grass. Xiaoming said, "I think these dew drops are really beautiful, just like little stars." Lili said, "I also think they are very pretty. Let's ask Grandma why there are dew drops." They went home and asked Grandma. Grandma smiled and said, "After White Dew, the weather gets cooler at night. Water vapor in the air meets the cold grass leaves and turns into small water droplets. That is dew." Xiaoming and Lili were happy to hear this. They took a small cup and went back to the park to collect dew drops. Lili said, "Let's use these dew drops to water the flowers at home." Xiaoming said, "Good idea, the dew drops must be very clean." They carefully poured the dew drops into the cup. The autumn morning was cool, and they felt very comfortable. When they got home, they poured the dew drops over the flowers. The flowers seemed even more beautiful. Grandma said, "You are so thoughtful." Xiaoming and Lili both smiled.
